_doc: Category-28 (Nuts, Seeds, and Their Butters) compiler config for tools/standards/compile-cat28.mjs — HMTc Method v2.0 (government-limit default). Numbers come ONLY from data/evidence/regulatory_limits.csv, selected per subcategory by explicit scope regex and the strictest applicable credible sovereign maximum, in the row's native basis. Occurrence evidence is descriptive market characterisation and can NEVER select an initial limit.
_method_note: native_basis is as_sold (dry commodity / paste) for every subcategory; reconstitution_8to1 is false everywhere and exclude_as_consumed drops prepared-state MLs. Cd, Pb, tAs, tHg, and Ni are government-regulated for the nut/seed family and resolve to the strictest sovereign ML. iAs (arsenic does not accumulate in nuts/seeds and no government sets a nut/seed iAs ML), total Cr, Cr-VI, Sn, and MeHg resolve to disclosed not-material / control determinations (default_read_across), each with a mandatory reference method. Al is a no-ML control.
_scope_note: ACCUMULATOR SPLITS ARE PRESERVED. Sunflower seeds are a known cadmium accumulator: the EU sets sunflower/linseed Cd at 500 ug/kg, five times the general-oilseed ceiling of 100; the sunflower subcategories therefore scope Cd to 'sunflower' ALONE so they bind 500 and never inherit the stricter general-oilseed 100. Sunflower IS an oilseed, so its Pb/tAs/tHg are the Israel FCS-2016 oilseed MLs, added via analyte_scope (regulatory-alignment). Cashews are a high-nickel tree nut: EU and Switzerland set cashew Ni at 10000 (vs the general tree-nut 3500); cashews scope Ni to the cashew-listed row and EXCLUDE the 'tree nuts except ... cashew nuts' 3500 row (which carves cashew OUT), and take tree-nut Cd 200. Cashew is NOT an oilseed, so its Pb/tAs/tHg are disclosed read-across from the nearest sovereign nut/seed anchor (Israel oilseeds), not claimed as direct government limits. nuts-seeds-other and nut-seed-butters-other are the tree-nut + non-sunflower-oilseed catch-alls: they bind the strictest applicable family ML per analyte (oilseeds-general Cd 100 protects the oilseed members; EU general tree-nut Ni 3500 with the high-nickel listed nuts — walnut, pine, Brazil, chestnut — carrying a deliberately looser EU 10000 disclosed here). Colour-additive purity specs and edible-oil MLs (oils of arachis/coconut/etc.) are excluded: a refined oil and an additive spec are a different product form from the whole nut/seed.
lineage: Cat-28 government-limit-default compile (HMTc Method v2.0). Anchors: EU Reg. 2023/915 (Cd: sunflower/linseed 500, tree nuts 200, oilseeds general 100, pine nuts 300), EU Reg. 2024/1987 (Ni: tree nuts 3500 / listed high-Ni nuts incl. cashew 10000 / sunflower seed 8000), Israel FCS-2016 (oilseeds: Pb 1000 / Cd 500 / tAs 1000 / tHg 400), Switzerland VHK 2026 (cashew Ni 10000).

Cr.control: No credible sovereign government sets a total-chromium contaminant maximum for nuts, seeds, or their butters in any jurisdiction (the only register total-Cr MLs are for dairy powder, drinking water, and fertiliser). Under the government-limit-only method HMTc publishes no standalone numeric total-Cr limit for this matrix; total chromium is monitored and hexavalent chromium is controlled by reflex speciation (see Cr-VI).
Cr.reference_method: Total-Cr screen by ICP-MS on every lot; investigate any elevated total-Cr result and reflex-speciate per the Cr-VI control.

Cr-VI.control: No government sets a total-chromium or hexavalent-chromium maximum level for any nut, seed, or nut/seed butter in any jurisdiction. Chromium in this matrix is dominated by nutritionally-essential Cr(III), and Cr(VI) reduces to Cr(III) in the oil-rich, organic matrix. Firm control: reflex speciation - any total-Cr result >= 100 ug/kg triggers Cr(VI) speciation, and any quantifiable Cr(VI) fails; Cr(VI) is never a panel number.
Cr-VI.reference_method: Total-Cr screen by ICP-MS; on any result >= 100 ug/kg, Cr(VI) by EN 15192 / EPA 6800 IC-ICP-MS isotope-dilution; LOQ-level quantifiable Cr(VI) = fail.
Cr-VI.regulatory_basis: No regulatory total-Cr or Cr(VI) ML for nut/seed/butter products in any jurisdiction; the only register total-Cr MLs are for dairy powder, drinking water, and fertiliser.
Cr-VI.jurisdictions_checked: EU 2023/915; EU 2024/1987; Israel FCS-2016; Switzerland VHK 2026; MERCOSUR GMC 12/2011; Codex CXS 193; FDA; AU/NZ Sch 19; China GB 2762

Sn.control: Every government tin maximum level in the register is scoped to canned / tin-coated product; tin migrates from tinplate, and that packaging-migration pathway is the contamination these MLs regulate. Nuts, seeds, and their butters are not sold in tinplate, so that pathway is absent; any tin present is dietary background rather than tinplate migration. Canned nut/seed products route to the canned-foods category and carry the tin ML there.
Sn.reference_method: Mandatory total-element screen by ICP-MS; tin is screened but not a binding numeric ceiling for non-canned product.
Sn.regulatory_basis: Tin MLs (EU/UK/GSO/IN 50000+ ug/kg canned) apply to canned product only; no non-canned nut/seed Sn ML exists in any jurisdiction.
Sn.jurisdictions_checked: EU 2023/915; EU 2024/1987; Israel FCS-2016; Switzerland VHK 2026; MERCOSUR GMC 12/2011; Codex CXS 193; FDA; AU/NZ Sch 19; China GB 2762

Al.control: No credible sovereign government sets an aluminium contaminant maximum for plain nuts, seeds, or their butters. Under the government-limit-only method HMTc publishes no standalone numeric Al limit for this matrix; naturally present or additive-derived aluminium remains a surveillance and formulation-control issue governed by the additive rules of the markets of sale.
Al.reference_method: Screen total Al by ICP-MS and document any aluminium-containing additive or processing-aid use; investigate elevated results and comply with all additive rules in markets of sale.

MeHg.control: No government sets a methylmercury ML for any nut, seed, or nut/seed butter in any jurisdiction; methylmercury maximum levels exist only for fish and seafood. Nuts and seeds are not a mercury-methylation matrix, and any mercury present is controlled by and bounded by the total-mercury ceiling for the subcategory (Israel FCS-2016 oilseeds tHg 400 ug/kg). No methylmercury ML exists to look up.
MeHg.reference_method: MeHg by GC-ICP-MS / EN 16801 only on a lot whose total mercury approaches the tHg ceiling; nut/seed methylmercury is characteristically < LOQ.
MeHg.regulatory_basis: No regulatory MeHg ML for nut/seed/butter products in any jurisdiction; methylmercury MLs are scoped to fish and seafood only. Total mercury is bounded by Israel FCS-2016 oilseeds tHg 400 ug/kg.
MeHg.jurisdictions_checked: EU 2023/915; EU 2024/1987; Israel FCS-2016; Switzerland VHK 2026; MERCOSUR GMC 12/2011; Codex CXS 193; FDA; AU/NZ Sch 19; China GB 2762

iAs.control: No government sets an inorganic-arsenic maximum level for any nut, seed, or nut/seed butter in any jurisdiction; inorganic-arsenic MLs are scoped to rice, rice products, and a few specific matrices where arsenic hyperaccumulates. Arsenic does not accumulate in nuts or seeds, and any arsenic present is bounded by the total-arsenic ceiling for the subcategory (Israel FCS-2016 oilseeds tAs 1000 ug/kg). No inorganic-arsenic ML exists to look up.
iAs.reference_method: iAs by HPLC-ICP-MS (EN 16802) only on a lot whose total arsenic approaches the tAs ceiling; nut/seed inorganic arsenic is characteristically < LOQ.
iAs.regulatory_basis: No regulatory iAs ML for nut/seed/butter products in any jurisdiction; inorganic-arsenic MLs are scoped to rice and a few hyperaccumulating matrices. Total arsenic is bounded by Israel FCS-2016 oilseeds tAs 1000 ug/kg.
iAs.jurisdictions_checked: EU 2023/915; EU 2024/1987; Israel FCS-2016; Switzerland VHK 2026; MERCOSUR GMC 12/2011; Codex CXS 193; FDA; AU/NZ Sch 19; China GB 2762

nuts-seeds-other.name: Nuts and seeds (tree nuts and non-sunflower oilseeds — almonds, walnuts, pistachios, hazelnuts, pine/Brazil nuts, sesame, flax, pumpkin, other)

Pb.label: read-across from Israel FCS-2016 oilseeds and olives Pb 1000 ug/kg (nearest sovereign nut/seed lead anchor; no tree-nut-specific Pb ML exists)

tAs.label: read-across from Israel FCS-2016 oilseeds tAs 1000 ug/kg (nearest sovereign nut/seed total-arsenic anchor)

tHg.label: read-across from Israel FCS-2016 oilseeds tHg 400 ug/kg (nearest sovereign nut/seed total-mercury anchor)

nut-seed-butters-other.name: Nut and seed butters (almond, cashew, tahini/sesame, and other non-sunflower non-peanut butters)
nut-seed-butters-other.scope_note: Nut and seed butters are mechanically-ground nuts/seeds with no legislated basis change; the whole-commodity nut/seed maximum levels govern them directly (regulatory-alignment), scoped identically to the nuts-seeds-other row.

sunflower-seed-butter.name: Sunflower seed butter (ground sunflower seeds)
sunflower-seed-butter.scope_note: Sunflower seed butter is mechanically-ground sunflower seeds; the sunflower-seed maximum levels govern it directly (regulatory-alignment). Cadmium binds the sunflower/linseed accumulator ML (500), not the general-oilseed 100.
